entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have a deep connection to the primal world and can channel this link into powerful effects once a day.

Note: This feat was designed or intended for members of a named organization that can not be referenced here. For the original wording please see the source material.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, member of an order.

Benefit(s): Once per day as a move action, you gain DR 5/cold iron for 1 minute. If you have 11 or more Hit Dice, this increases to DR 10/cold iron. Additionally, while under this effect, enchantment spells you cast gain a +1 bonus to caster level.
